entities.summary: Tanzania is a sovereign nation in East Africa, Africa. Its capital is Dodoma (official/legislative) / Dar es Salaam (commercial/administrative). Official languages include Swahili (Kiswahili), English. Government: Unitary presidential constitutional republic. Population: approximately 65.5 million. Area: 945,087 km². Comprehensive index for Tanzania covering Olduvai Gorge, Kilwa Sultanate, Zanzibar slave trade, German East Africa (Maji Maji), British Tanganyika, Nyerere ujamaa socialism, Zanzibar revolution, union, and Serengeti/Ngorongoro heritage.
